Package index

Areas of interest

Read an AOI and rasterize it onto a template or a new grid.

rasterize_aoi()
Rasterize an area of interest
read_aoi()
Read an area of interest

Vector layers

Read one layer of a vector file as stored.

read_layer()
Read one layer of a vector file

Rasters

Align, polygonize and write rasters.

align_raster()
Align a raster to a template
polygonize_raster()
Polygonize a raster, by cell or by value
write_raster_file()
Write a raster to one file
write_rasters()
Write rasters to files

rij matrices and extraction

Read layers as rij matrices, clip them to an AOI, rebuild rasters and extract many layers at once.

clip_rij_matrix()
Clip an rij matrix to an area of interest
extract_layers()
Extract many layers for an area of interest
read_rij_matrix()
Read a layer as an rij matrix
rij_matrix_to_raster()
Rebuild rasters from an rij matrix

natdata_template()

read_natdata_metadata()
Read the NAT_DATA layer catalogue
